00 — Description

Project objective.

This project simulates a realistic load on a Flask authentication API with Redis session management. The goal: validate the stability of the architecture under 100 concurrent connections and demonstrate a production-level system diagnosis approach.

Beyond performance testing, the project covers the diagnosis of a Python binary incompatibility (ABI mismatch), resolved through isolation in a virtual environment.

Skills demonstrated
REST API architecture + distributed sessions
Load testing with Locust (scripting + spawn rate)
Python ABI diagnosis — greenlet / gevent
Python environment management (venv / pip)
Full validation — 100 users, 0 errors

02 — Diagnosis & Resolution

Issue encountered & solution.

A Python ABI conflict was blocking Locust on startup. Precise diagnosis, clean fix.

❌
Error detected
ValueError — greenlet ABI mismatch

The Locust version installed via apt created a binary conflict with gevent and greenlet. Mixing system Python with pip causes an immediate crash.

# Error message
ValueError: greenlet.greenlet
size changed, may indicate
binary incompatibility

# Cause: broken system version
sudo apt install python3-locust
✓
Solution applied
Clean reinstall inside venv

Removed the system version, activated an isolated virtualenv, and reinstalled exclusively via pip. Result: stable startup, 0 errors, 100 users tested successfully.

# Remove system version
sudo apt remove python3-locust -y

# Activate clean environment
source venv/bin/activate

# Reinstall correctly
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install locust

✓ locust --version → 2.x.x OK
Pro rule — keep in mind
For any Python package (locust, flask, redis-py, pytest): never use apt — always use pip inside an isolated virtualenv. Mixing them creates ABI conflicts on compiled C extensions.
